eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 12:43 AM on AUG 24, 2022 Effective until 10:43 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police is looking for white male, Thomas Holland, height, 5 foot 5 inches, weight, 175 pounds, eyes, green, hair, red. Last seen on foot in the area of North 27th Avenue and West Northern Avenue. Unknown clothing. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
